# 🚀 Deployment Checklist

- [ ] Target environment and owner confirmed.
- [ ] Runtime and configuration verified.
- [ ] Required secrets configured outside source control.
- [ ] Build artifact generated from identified commit.
- [ ] Static route fallback configured if required.
- [ ] HTTPS and domain verified.
- [ ] Browser storage origin implications reviewed.
- [ ] Deployment completed.
- [ ] Smoke tests executed.
- [ ] Monitoring and alert paths checked.
- [ ] Rollback method available.
- [ ] Deployment evidence recorded.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Commit/artifact | [SHA / identifier] |
| Environment | [Name] |
| Operator | [Name] |
| Time | [Timestamp + timezone] |
| Result | [Actual result] |
